title: Add unified @mindory/llm SDK

context.summary: Replace the narrow @mindory/model-runtime package with @mindory/llm as the single SDK boundary for model operations.
context.background: Installer and multimodal processing requirements need one component for chat, embeddings, OCR, ASR, vision, face, image generation and audio generation roles. Backward compatibility with MINDORY_MODEL_RUNTIME_* names is not required.

in: Rename the model runtime package boundary to @mindory/llm.
Rename canonical model configuration namespace to MINDORY_LLM_*.
Define typed LLM roles for chat, text embeddings, image embeddings, OCR, ASR, vision captioning, face detection, face recognition, image generation and audio generation.
Define provider contracts, disabled provider behavior and operation result/audit metadata shape in the SDK.
Update current API/worker consumers and validators to import @mindory/llm instead of @mindory/model-runtime.
Update docs and generated .env.example for the new SDK boundary.
out: Implementing new OCR/ASR/vision/face providers beyond existing placeholders.

acceptance_criteria: packages/llm defines @mindory/llm and packages/model-runtime is removed from workspace validation.
Current model calls route through @mindory/llm imports and no runtime package depends on @mindory/model-runtime.
Config catalog and .env.example use MINDORY_LLM_* names instead of MINDORY_MODEL_RUNTIME_* names.
@mindory/llm exposes roles, provider contracts, disabled behavior and operation result/audit metadata types for the required model operation classes.
Validators fail if @mindory/model-runtime references or MINDORY_MODEL_RUNTIME_* env names remain in runtime code/docs.
No database schema changes are included.

manual_checks: Confirm no @mindory/model-runtime imports remain outside historical task docs.
Confirm no MINDORY_MODEL_RUNTIME_* env names remain in runtime code, docs, Compose or .env.example.

risks: Renaming package and env namespace touches many validators and docs; generated config validation must guard drift.
Existing text embedding behavior must remain functionally equivalent while moving under the broader LLM SDK name.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
